Duplicating the Postgres block is reusable but insufficient: it omits scheme mapping (dburl aliases cockroach to postgres) and Cockroach migration-driver work.

Misstates the protobuf runtime: fields map by protobuf tag number, not position; reordered struct fields work and no order/count mismatch panic exists.
PNG holds only when resizing runs; small images (originalSize <= size) return early, so a square JPEG stays JPEG. Stated unconditionally.
True for whole-file parsing, but gofmt's stdin path accepts fragments without a package clause; stated as a general requirement.
DB is used only on the refresh path; cached results with matching language skip all DB calls, yet the claim is unconditional.
Exhaustive scope claim omits the OCI Source/NewSource obligations; but those sit in a separate interface section, so the 'Requirements' section may be artwork-only.
Wrong endpoint: crdb is a package inside module github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach-go, and the proxy's @v/list needs the module path.
Requirements also cover recent-chat pagination/rooms, escaped teasers, user status and private-room IDs; 'only raw' leaves these out.
The HTTP controller computes stop=39 for start=20, perPage=20, so stop is never undefined; route errors map to 400, not 500.
Wrong identifier: go-redis v9.0.5 Options names the idle-lifetime field ConnMaxIdleTime, not MaxConnIdleTime.
Equivalence holds for start/stop inputs but not valid page-only requests, which a pre-conversion isFinite check rejects; stated for all valid inputs.
The issue says the diff function must accept plus/minus booleans; the claim assigns this to helper getDiffCves, the wrong function.
URL construction from protocol/host/name happens in sql.parse; config.Load leaves the URL empty, so the behavior is attributed to the wrong function.
server/public and server/subsonic only consume artwork.Artwork; the implementation is *artwork in core/artwork. Wrong code location.
Only keyed struct literals need field names; Go also allows unkeyed positional literals, so the first clause is stated too broadly.
Misremembered behavior: --diff output includes updated existing CVEs as well as new ones and prints raw CVE IDs without a + prefix.
Returns Version only for PEP 440-valid strings; setuptools 58.1.0 returns LegacyVersion otherwise (e.g. 'not-a-version'). Stated unconditionally.
Plainly false about the repo: report/util_test.go already defines TestDiff, which exercises diff() on current/previous scan results.
check_qt_version compares encoded ints and the runtime version against 5.12.0; it never compares runtime to compiled versions. Misdescribes the function.
The Postgres migration driver uses pg_advisory_lock, unsupported by CockroachDB; pinned golang-migrate ships a dedicated cockroachdb driver. Wrong mechanism.
DefaultConfig returns its own literal and never calls setDefaults (only Load does), so Redis defaults must be added there too.
Test setup's system message creates message:1, so it exists; getMessageField returns a scalar, not an object like {content: null}.
The controller uses if (start), so a provided start=0 takes the page/perPage branch; the claim holds only for truthy start.
go.mod/go.sum pin canonical disintegration/imaging v1.6.2, matching upstream docs; nothing indicates a patched or forked copy.
PyQt5 5.15 types fromString as Tuple[QVersionNumber, int]; the second element is an int suffix index, not a str.
modules/chat.js calls api.get('/chats'), which resolves to GET /api/v3/chats; the agent's grep for '/api/' missed it.
The override is consulted only after the parsed UA, so it doesn't control quirk injection; real 5.15.2 with override 6.3 still needs the polyfill.
DB 0 and 1 are valid, but standalone Redis also accepts DB 2 and higher; the claim leaves out other valid database indices.
SQL files may be reusable, but the issue requires golang-migrate's cockroachdb driver; the Postgres driver's advisory locks fail on CockroachDB.
Valid ids are not sufficient: unauthorized callers get not-allowed and missing pagination gets invalid-data. Holds only under those extra conditions.
Wrong identity: package.json and repo URL name matrix-react-sdk 3.74.0; element-web is the separate skin. Version right, name wrong.
The debug and signalfilter uses are real, but tests/unit/utils/test_debug.py also calls debug.signal_name; the 'only' list misses it.
The guard is uid <= 0, which rejects null but lets undefined through; the presence requirement holds only for the tested null cases.
Issue wants Qt-native QVersionNumber comparisons, not pkg_resources semantics; yet normalized QVersionNumbers compare like zero-padding, so the 1.2 vs 1.2.0 counterexample is weak.
Success also needs authorization and valid pagination; unauthorized calls with valid ids return not-allowed. The claim overstates the success domain.
Normalization is needed, but reparsing via parse_version is not: QLibraryInfo.version() is already a QVersionNumber and can call .normalized() directly.
